# Adonias Nigussie

> Growth and performance marketer based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (GMT+3), working remotely with US and EU teams. Specialties: outbound customer acquisition, paid media (Meta, Google, TikTok), SEO and content strategy, and AI-driven marketing workflows. Open to international remote roles and freelance engagements.

Key verified results: 1,000+ outbound leads per month at 23% open and 6% reply (Pairing.dev, Estonia); up to 300% client lead-generation lift across 30+ paid campaigns (Eagle Eye Business Group); a B2B product scaled from 100 to 500 customers in 12 months (Jaktech); top-3 Google rankings for 14 long-tail keywords and a ~70% client sales lift (Recognise Designs, UK); ~70% campaign execution time cut via n8n and LLM automation.
